Junaid Ali Mehraj Ali Rayeeni ...A
 Versus
 State of Maharashtra ...R
Mr. Nehal Desale a/w Aditya Andhorikar, for the Applicant.
Ms. Megha S. Bajoria, App for the Respondent - State.
Coram Dr. Neela Gokhale, J.

Dated: 11Th February 2026
 Pc:-
 1.

By this Application, the Applicant seeks his  enlargement on bail in connection with C.R.No. 20 of 2026  dated 15th January, 2026 registered with the Mira Road Police  Station, District Mira Bhayandar, Vasai Virar, for the offences  punishable under Sections 123, 223, 272, 275 and 3(5) of the  Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023 ('BNS') and Sections 26(2),
26(4) and 30(2)(a) of the Food Safety and Standard Act,
 2006 and Section 7 of the Prohibition of Electronic Cigarettes  Act, 2019.

The Applicant made an application seeking bail  before the Additional Sessions Judge, Thane, however, by  order dated 29th January, 2026, the said application was  rejected.
Hence, the Applicant has filed the present Bail  Application for the relief as prayed.

3. Mr. Desale, learned counsel for the Applicant,
 pointed out that the issue is pending before the Supreme  Court.
He submits that the Applicant has suffered  incarceration for the past one month.

Moreover, this Court has  already held that mere possession, transportation, storage or  sale of Pan Masala packets would not attract Section 328 of  the IPC (Section 123 of the BNS) and the said issue is now  pending before the Supreme Court.

4. Ms. Bajoria, learned APP representing the State,
 states that the charge-sheet is not yet filed and the Applicant  has antecedent in similar offences.
